scripts.db:local:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.override.yml rm -fsv postgres && docker volume rm backend-djuanda-postgres-data
scripts.db:local:up: docker compose --env-file .env.development -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.override.yml up -d pgbouncer postgres
scripts.db:local:migrate: cmd /c "set DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/backend_djuanda && set AEROSWARM_AIRPORT_ID=WARR && bun run --cwd packages/database db:migrate"
scripts.db:local:seed: cmd /c "set DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/backend_djuanda && set AEROSWARM_AIRPORT_ID=WARR && bun run --cwd packages/database seed-alert-rules.ts"
